title: Title Guaranty of Hawaii buyer origin by district (all four island PDFs): 2025 full year and Jan-Jun 2026, with 2024 and Jan-Jun 2025 comparisons

source.publisher: Title Guaranty of Hawaii, LLC - Buyer Statistics ("Where do buyers of Hawaii property come from?")

editions_used.2024FY_original: Q4 2024 edition, current-period column (old Hawaii Island district definitions)
editions_used.supplementary: Q4 2024 prior column (2023), Q2 2025 edition (Jan-Jun 2025 and Jan-Jun 2024), Q1 2026 edition (Jan-Mar 2026 and Jan-Mar 2025)

source.raw_dir: scratchpad/raw/tg/ (downloaded 2026-10-08 by KEY=tg; sha256 re-verified against raw/tg/MANIFEST.txt in this run)

method: Each island PDF has one district page: a panel per district (name, share of island sales %, HI/US/FOREIGN pie %, a table of up to 5 states incl. HI and up to 3 countries with # and $ for the current and prior period) and a foot row with one column per district: "<cur> VS <prior> US TOTAL" and "<cur> <prior> FOREIGN TOTAL".
Words were read with pdfplumber (doubled text objects de-duplicated; pull/gap_tg_districts/districts.py). A merged token on the Hawaii Island foot row ("VS681") is split by regex.

Foot-row columns carry no district name. Each column was linked to its panel by vector fill colour: the highlighted district in the column's mini-map and the panel's donut-chart segment use the identical CMYK fill (same as the main map). A second, independent link (panel border stroke colour -> nearest mini-map fill) agreed for every panel in all 20 PDFs.

Per district and period: total_sales = US TOTAL + FOREIGN TOTAL; hawaii_buyers = HI row #; other_us_buyers = US TOTAL - HI (US TOTAL includes Hawaii buyers); foreign_buyers = FOREIGN TOTAL. Shares = count / total_sales (1 decimal).

Checks: district sums vs the island summary page total (current and prior period); district HI sum vs the island summary HI row (current period); district-sum shares vs published island HI/US/foreign shares; computed district shares vs the printed pie % and island-share %. Results in checks.
Cross-check: the 130 district-period records in an/new/tg.json (built earlier with a share-consistency matching instead of colours) were compared field by field; 0 differences.
notes: District names are TG's own, as printed. They differ from the names in the request. Oahu (6): Honolulu, East Honolulu, Leeward, Central, Windward, North Shore (no Ewa/Koolauloa/Koolaupoko/Waialua/Waianae districts). Maui County (8): Central, South Side, Up Country, West Side, North Shore, East Maui, Molokai, Lanai (no Lahaina/Kihei-Wailea/Wailuku-Kahului/Hana names). Hawaii Island (7): Puna, Kona, Kohala Coast, Hilo, Kau, North Kohala, Hamakua (no Waimea district). Kauai (5): Lihue, Koloa, Kawaihau, Hanalei, Waimea. TG publishes no boundary definitions beyond the coloured map; no name crosswalk was made.

Dollars: district total dollar volume is NOT printed. Printed per district: Hawaii-buyer dollars (HI row) and dollars for the listed top states (up to 4 besides HI) and top countries (up to 3). listed_* fields carry these with count coverage of the category; they are partial for most districts and must not be summed into district totals. Island totals in dollars come from the island summary page. All $ values are TG-rounded ($X.XB/$X.XM/$X.XK).

n<20: every district row has n_lt20_cells (which of total/HI/other-US/foreign counts are below 20) and small_n_flag_total_lt20. Districts with total sales < 20: East Maui and Lanai (2025, 2026H1, Jan-Jun 2025), East Maui (2024). Most foreign counts outside Honolulu are < 20; treat district foreign shares as indicative only. Hawaii Island North Kohala and Hamakua, Kauai Waimea and Maui Molokai have other-US counts < 20 in several periods.

Hawaii Island district redefinition: the Q4 2024 edition (posted Mar 2025) shows 2024 Kohala Coast 1,364 sales (HI 627 / other-US 706 / foreign 31; 35% of island) and Kona 90 (56/33/1; 2%), and 2023 Kohala Coast 1,310 and Kona 89. From the Q2 2025 edition on, the same districts are re-cut: the Q4 2025 edition restates 2024 as Kohala Coast 699 (289/392/18) and Kona 754 (394/346/14). The two together are unchanged (1,454 vs 1,453; HI 683 vs 683, other-US 739 vs 738, foreign 32 vs 32), so about 665 sales moved from Kohala Coast to Kona; the other five Hawaii Island districts are identical in both editions. The printed map and district names did not change and TG gives no explanation. The Q1 2025 edition, which would date the change more precisely, could not be checked: its link on the TG market page redirects to the home page (see MANIFEST). Use 2024FY_restated (or 2024H1/2025H1 from the Q2 2025+ editions) for Kohala Coast/Kona trends; 2023FY and 2024FY_original are on the old basis.

Other restatements of 2024 between the Q4 2024 and Q4 2025 editions: Maui Up Country 243 -> 260 (+17, other-US 37 -> 52), South Side 444 -> 435 (other-US 193 -> 179), Central 374 -> 365; Oahu Honolulu 4,698 -> 4,694, Central 1,746 -> 1,751, North Shore 151 -> 147, Windward and East Honolulu -1 each. Jan-Jun 2025 republished in the Q2 2026 edition: only Maui Central 172 -> 170 and South Side 147 -> 149 changed. Full list in revisions.

Anomalies kept as published: Hawaii Island Hilo 2024 has 279 other-US buyers incl. CA 232 ($35.0M, about $151K each) against 88 other-US in 2025, so Hilo (and Hawaii Island) 2024 other-US shares are inflated; Hilo total 668 (2024) vs 456 (2025). Kauai Lihue Jan-Jun 2026 = 66 sales vs 170 in Jan-Jun 2025 (-61%).

TG inconsistency (Kauai): in four of the five Kauai editions checked (all but Q1 2026), the country rows printed in the Koloa and Lihue panels do not match those districts' FOREIGN TOTAL foot values (e.g. 2025: Koloa panel lists Canada 1 but its foot FOREIGN TOTAL is 0, Lihue foot is 1 with no country listed; Jan-Jun 2026: Koloa foot 2 with none listed, Lihue lists Canada 2 with foot 0). The foot values agree with the printed pie % and are used; only 0-2 sales per period are affected. See country_list_vs_foreign_total_mismatches.

Category meaning: HAWAII / US / FOREIGN as labelled by TG; "other_us" = US TOTAL minus HI. TG does not document how origin is assigned (presumably buyer mailing address) or which transfers count. These are TG title-order counts, not MLS or county deed totals.
Periods are cumulative YTD: Q2 editions = Jan-Jun, Q4 = Jan-Dec. Compare 2026H1 with 2025H1_republished, not with 2025FY.
Privacy: aggregates only (counts and rounded dollar volumes by district and origin). No names, addresses or parcel ids are in the source or this file.
